units.title: Unit 1: Place Value, Rounding & Multi-Digit Arithmetic

lessons.title: Lesson 1a: Place Value & Rounding Multi-Digit Numbers
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Place Value & Rounding to Nearest 100 and 1,000
lessons.reading: In the base-ten system, each place is 10 times the place to its right. To round to the nearest hundred or thousand, look one digit to the right: 5 or more rounds up, and 4 or less stays the same.

principles.title: Rounding to Nearest Hundred and Thousand
principles.summary: Look one place to the right of the rounding place: 5 or more rounds up; 4 or less stays the same.

assignment.scopeSummary: [Place Value & Rounding] Micro-Lesson Scope (~10 min total): Complete ONLY the 3 bite-sized steps below for "Rounding to Nearest Hundred and Thousand" (4.NBT.A.3), then return to this tab for your randomized Mastery Check.

lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Adding & Subtracting Multi-Digit Whole Numbers
lessons.reading: Line up numbers by place value (ones, tens, hundreds, thousands). Regroup 10 smaller units into 1 larger unit when adding, or trade 1 larger unit for 10 smaller units when subtracting.

lessons.title: Lesson 2a: Multiplying 2-Digit Numbers by Area Model
lessons.reading: To multiply two 2-digit numbers like 24 × 16, break each number into tens and ones: (20 + 4) × (10 + 6). Multiply the four parts and add the partial products together.

lessons.title: Lesson 2b: Division with Remainders
lessons.reading: Division splits a number into equal groups. Any leftover amount is the remainder (R), which is always smaller than the divisor: Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder.

principles.title: Quotients and Remainders
principles.summary: Verify division using Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder, with Remainder < Divisor.

lessons.title: Lesson 3a: Equivalent Fractions & Adding Like Fractions
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Equivalent Fractions & Adding Fractions
lessons.reading: Multiply the top and bottom of a fraction by the same number to make an equivalent fraction. To add fractions with the same denominator, add the top numbers and keep the bottom number.

principles.title: Generating Equivalent Fractions
principles.summary: Multiply or divide numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number.

principles.title: Adding Fractions with Like Denominators
principles.summary: Add numerators while keeping the like denominator unchanged.

lessons.title: Lesson 3b: Decimals & Rectangle Area and Perimeter
lessons.videoTitle: Khan Academy: Decimals as Fractions & Area/Perimeter
lessons.reading: Two digits after a decimal point show hundredths (0.47 = 47/100). For a rectangle, perimeter is the distance around the outside (P = 2L + 2W) and area is the space inside (A = L × W).

principles.title: Decimals and Fractions in Tenths & Hundredths
principles.summary: Convert between decimal notation and fractions with denominators of 10 or 100.

principles.title: Area and Perimeter Formulas for Rectangles
principles.summary: Use Area = L × W and Perimeter = 2(L + W) to solve measurement problems.

lessons.title: Lesson 3c (Ohio): Angle Addition & Decomposing Angles
lessons.reading: An angle is measured in degrees (°). A right angle is 90° and a straight line is 180°. When an angle is split into two smaller angles side by side, their measures add up to the whole angle.

principles.title: Additive Angle Measurement & Decomposing Angles
principles.summary: Add and subtract adjacent angle measures, including complementary (90°) and supplementary (180°) angles.
